headline: 电影热作与剧集新番双线升温
summary: 电影端《挖掘者》《不存在的罪人》等热作领跑，待映片单含《沙丘3》《复仇者联盟5》；剧集端《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》本周首播，《菜鸟老警》《龙族》持续热播。

headlineEn: Films and TV series heat up on both fronts
summaryEn: On the film side, The Digger and The Nonexistent Sinner lead current hits, with Dune 3 and Avengers 5 on the upcoming slate; on TV, Witch Academy and Equip Me Strongest premiere this week, while The Rookie and House of the Dragon remain popular.
